text: In addition to daily walks, open the window for 3–5 minutes twice a day. Stand in front of the window, inhale fresh air, feel its purity and oxygen fullness. And on the exhale, feel that along with the air, inner tension and difficult emotions leave you, and you switch to what is outside the window, rather than inside your apartment or office. This simple action sharply improves your state: the integral pattern of breathing is restored, your head becomes clearer and your heart calmer.
